data.name: Emily
data.gender_notes: Emily is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Aemilia, from aemulus, 'rival' or 'emulating'. Its root is Latin aemulus. A common Christian name. Emily is a Latin name meaning “Rival; (also) industrious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emily expresses “Rival; (also) industrious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin Aemilia, from aemulus, 'rival' or 'emulating'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emily total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
